title: Pork Ramen with Japanese Flair
description: A German twist on the popular Japanese noodle dish, featuring pork and a rich broth.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine pork shoulder, sake, and water.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
3. Cook pork for 1-2 hours, or until tender.
4. Meanwhile, prepare ramen noodles according to package instructions.
5. In a separate pan, heat sesame oil over medium heat.
6. Add honey and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until dissolved.
7. Add shio tare and stir to combine.
8. To assemble the dish, place noodles in a bowl, then add sliced pork.
9. Spoon the sesame oil mixture over the top, then garnish with green onions.
